data: {{Top}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Thodibin.png]] |name=Thodibin |homeworld=[[Chanceuxi]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Suerton]]{{StoryCite|story=The Ride|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Green]] |cyber= |families=new |parents=*[[Thodibin's father]] *[[Thodi's mother|Thodibin's mother]] |partners=new |siblings=*[[Dodibin]] *[[Wodibin]] |children=new |affiliation=[[Lucky Three]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Thodibin''', nicknamed '''Thodi''', was a [[Gender|male]] [[Suerton]] who resided in [[Canto Bight]] and spent a night, along with his younger brothers [[Dodibin]] and [[Wodibin]], [[gambling]] with [[Kaljach Sonmi]]. He preferred to go by his nickname Thodi.
